SELECT p.page_id, p.page_title, p.display_platform, p.url, p.page_desc, p.page_content, p.seo_config, p.publish_status, p.check_status, p.apply_reason, p.publish_time, p.sort_weight, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.version, p.del_flag, p.user_id, p.org_id, CASE WHEN p.publish_status = 1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM page_manager_info p2 WHERE p2.url <=> p.url AND p2.display_platform <=> p.display_platform AND ( CASE WHEN p2.publish_status = 1 THEN p2.version ELSE -1 END > CASE WHEN p.publish_status = 1 THEN p.version ELSE -1 END OR ( CASE WHEN p2.publish_status = 1 THEN p2.version ELSE -1 END = CASE WHEN p.publish_status = 1 THEN p.version ELSE -1 END AND p2.version > p.version ) OR ( CASE WHEN p2.publish_status = 1 THEN p2.version ELSE -1 END = CASE WHEN p.publish_status = 1 THEN p.version ELSE -1 END AND p2.version = p.version AND p2.page_id > p.page_id ) ) ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END as publish_version FROM page_manager_info p
and p.del_flag = '0' and p.page_title like concat('%',#{pageTitle},'%') and p.url = #{url} and p.display_platform = #{displayPlatform} and p.page_desc = #{pageDesc} and p.page_content = #{pageContent} and p.seo_config = #{seoConfig} and p.publish_status = #{publishStatus} and p.check_status = #{checkStatus} and p.apply_reason = #{applyReason} and p.publish_time = #{publishTime} and p.sort_weight = #{sortWeight} and p.version = #{version} and p.user_id = #{userId} and p.org_id = #{orgId}
and date_format(p.create_time,'%Y%m%d') >= date_format(#{params.beginTime},'%Y%m%d')
and date_format(p.create_time,'%Y%m%d') <= date_format(#{params.endTime},'%Y%m%d')
ORDER BY p.url ,p.display_platform,p.version
